prompt: The second stage of the reference creature, for a monster-collecting RPG: a longer, springier young ferret, leaner and taller than the round reference, standing upright on its hind legs in a boxer's stance with both front paws raised as little fists. A long fluffy bottle-brush tail crackling with pale-gold sparks. Big friendly dark eyes, spunky and determined. Three-quarter view facing right. Crisp dark outline, clean clustered pixel shading. Not a mouse, not a rabbit, not a cat, not yellow, no red cheeks, no clothing. Exactly one creature on a plain white background.
